text: LogicAsker did not prove that GPT-4 has flawless logical reasoning; in fact, it demonstrated the opposite. According to the research [2401.00757], LogicAsker was developed specifically to evaluate and enhance the logical reasoning capabilities of large language models. The study found "significant gaps in LLMs' learning of logical rules," reporting that reasoning failures in the models tested ranged from 29% to 90%. LogicAsker used these findings of reasoning failures to help improve model performance, but it highlighted the inherent limitations in their logical reasoning rather than proving it to be flawless.
